name: rfid-elegoo
title: Elegoo Filament Tag
author: bespoked
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Decoder for Elegoo's published NTAG EPC-256 tag layout (material, color, diameter, weight), anchored on Elegoo's manufacturer signature in the raw page dump. IMPORTANT (verified on a real U1, 2026-06-29): the FACTORY Elegoo Centauri spool tags do NOT read on the U1 today. The cause is the U1 reader's antenna coupling with that specific tag, not this decoder and not a locked tag: the data is open NTAG213 memory, but the reader gets no RF wake-up response from the factory tag, across the entire register space and both coils, while M1/NTAG read fine and phones/Canvas read the Elegoo. The decoder is correct and ready for any Elegoo tag presenting the published layout (or the day the reader can wake the factory tag). Workaround: an OpenSpool NTAG on the opposite side of the spool ring. See the doc for full findings + a community call to action. Requires the RFID Spool Reader. Read-only.
tagline: Elegoo NTAG EPC-256 decoder (factory U1 tags blocked by reader RF, see doc).
